function tableMonthDifference(
  calendar: 'chinese' | 'dangi',
  oneYear: number,
  oneMonth: number,
  twoYear: number,
  twoMonth: number
): number {
  return hostCalendarData
    ? hostCalendarMonthDifference(
        calendar,
        oneYear,
        oneMonth,
        twoYear,
        twoMonth
      )
    : tableMonthSerial(calendar, twoYear, twoMonth) -
        tableMonthSerial(calendar, oneYear, oneMonth)
}
